info.title: Fusion Bot Public Developer & Agent API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API and Model Context Protocol interface for Fusion Bot.

scopes.bot:read: Read bot telemetry, live shard statistics, latency, and public server counts
scopes.bot:write: Manage bot server nicknames, branding settings, and prefix configurations
scopes.guilds:read: Read server configurations, automod settings, channels, and active roles
scopes.guilds:write: Update server configurations, toggle security modules, and configure channels
scopes.backup:create: Create instant manual or automated snapshots of server structure to Fusion Cloud / Google Drive
scopes.backup:restore: Reconstruct server categories, channels, permissions, and member roles from snapshots
scopes.moderation:manage: Execute automated moderation rules (ban, kick, timeout, purge, channel lockdown)
scopes.tickets:manage: Deploy ticket panels, manage support categories, and archive transcripts
